summary: Tested the Base commune CareerOS shared knowledge base from start to finish. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass (admin /knowledge auth and anonymous-only fields plus stats, one card per employer, /knowledge/match variants and 401, two Radar runs on the same day do not double-increment validations, a blocked alternative never replaces a working card). Frontend member: the Réglages company filter hides associated companies by default, the info text and toggle work, adding 'Desjardins Groupe' auto-associates from the base commune (toast, Workday + AUTO badge, hidden until the toggle is used, persisted after Enregistrer), the quick 'Associer · Workday' button works on an imported 'Walmart Canada Inc', plain 'Associer' runs discovery and shows a Jooble fallback toast, and a blocked card shows 'SuccessFactors bloqué (403) · Jooble'. Admin: the Base commune tab shows KPIs, rows, KPI detail dialogs and the validations confidence dialog. One a11y bug fixed: Enter on a KPI card did not open the dialog.

minor.endpoint: KB.lookup fallback (knowledge.py:64-67) used by /knowledge/match, detect_one and add-company
minor.issue: Token subset matching gives false positives for generic or one-word names: 'Québec' and 'Hydro' -> Hydro-Québec, 'Montréal' -> Ville de Montréal, 'Amazon Web Services' -> Amazon. These cards are usable, so the wrong employer portal is AUTO-associated. Suggest requiring >=2 shared tokens, or the card's token set being a subset of the query name (not the reverse) when the query has only 1 token, or a minimum token length.
recent_offers and last_success are not set, so the admin table shows an empty 'Offres lues' cell for blocked cards. Default them to 0 / ''.
'canada' is stripped, so 'Canada' / 'Postes Canada' style names reduce to 0 or 1 tokens: an empty key means the card is never recorded, and single tokens make false-positive matches more likely.

ui_bugs.issue: Pressing Enter on a focused KPI did not open the detail dialog (Space did). FIXED by adding e.preventDefault() in onKeyDown. Retested: Enter now opens the dialog.

issues: The settings tour (Visite des réglages) auto-opens and its popover covers the add-company row and the 'Ajouter' button. A first click on Ajouter is swallowed until the tour is skipped.
Blocked row shows 'Jooble' twice (kind column 'Jooble' + 'SuccessFactors bloqué (403) · Jooble').

Sobeys is counted in 'Bloquées par l'employeur' (from its member-level detected label) but its row shows a generic 'Associer' button, not the blocked badge, because the shared base has no blocked card for it. The two signals are inconsistent.

action_items: Tighten KB.lookup fuzzy matching to avoid generic one-token matches (Québec, Montréal, Hydro) that auto-associate the wrong employer
Set recent_offers=0 when creating a blocked card
Prevent the settings tour popover from covering the add-company row (or skip the tour when the user interacts)
Optional: show the blocked badge in rows whose detected label says 'Bloqué' even without a KB card, and drop the duplicate 'Jooble' label
critical_code_review_comments: knowledge.lookup does a full collection scan (async for over all cards) for every non-exact name. /knowledge/match calls it for up to 150 names, which is O(N*M). Fine now (12 cards) but it will not scale; precompute tokens or cache.
knowledge_match returns slug in addition to the public fields. This is acceptable (public employer info), but the admin and public schemas differ.
record(): when the same card is re-validated on a new day after being 'bloque', validations keeps counting from before. This is intended but worth documenting.
Migrated cards (Cascades) have last_success='' and stay 'faible' forever until a member's run re-validates them, so they are never usable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (1 a11y bug fixed)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily inserted the KB card 'TEST Bloquee Zorg' (bloque) to test the blocked UI, then deleted it. The cleanup also removed a stale 'TEST_BMO' card left by a previous agent. Test companies (Desjardins Groupe, Walmart Canada Inc, TEST_Inconnue Zzqx, TEST Bloquee Zorg) were removed. The member is back to their original 14 companies.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_knowledge_base.py triggers 2 Radar runs (~30s total). The member's settings tour auto-opens in the Réglages dialog: click the 'Passer' button before interacting. Set localStorage privacyAcceptedV2=1 and radarTourDone=1 before login. The server clock is Oct 2026.
